integrity.claim_scope: Composition-idempotents of syntactic monoid elements; word duplicates identified.
integrity.computer_checks: Two independent algorithms exhaust all transformations for 1<=r,s<=10; proof covers every positive r,s.
integrity.source_date_evidence: PMLR volume 217 explicitly states publication 2023-07-05; no earlier public version of the guiding work verified.

limitations: Only binary principal factor ideals with one positive zero-run followed by one positive one-run are covered.
The all-order theorem relies on its explicit DFA/retraction proof; finite enumeration alone does not prove infinite parameters.
The total syntactic cardinality is credited to previous literature; possible unindexed prior classifications remain a priority risk.
title: Idempotent retractions of binary two-run factor monoids
